content.short: SCV-Security provides security audits for app-chains and projects.
content.description: SCV-Security provides security services for projects building on Cosmos and CosmWasm. The platform combines in-depth security research with practical risk mitigation and a focus on elevating security awareness across teams. Through rigorous analysis, actionable guidance, and ongoing collaboration, SCV-Security translates research findings into real-world protections. With more than 15 years of cybersecurity experience and strong ties to the whitehat hacker community, SCV-Security is dedicated to strengthening the security posture of the Cosmos and CosmWasm ecosystems.
